instruction: A candid outdoor lifestyle photograph captured in a full shot at eye-level, showing two women walking forward on a grassy park with lush green trees in the background. On the left, the woman with curly brown hair (R5) walks in an olive green sports bra and matching leggings, holding a pink water bottle in her right hand and smiling warmly at her companion. On the right, the woman with blonde-highlighted hair (R3) walks in a maroon sports bra and matching leggings, looking forward with a relaxed expression. The two women are holding hands as they walk side-by-side. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused overcast daylight, creating a bright and natural green-dominated color palette.
